evaluation.pixel_rounding: floor after multiplication, then clip to [0,255]
evaluation.resize: Pillow 10.4.0 BILINEAR to 64x64 after source-resolution brightness transform

model.device: cuda:0 on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Laptop GPU
model.training_order: fixed manifest order task-1,task-2,task-4,task-5 at every step
model.initialization: reset torch.manual_seed and torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(3682) separately before constructing each arm

augmentation.scope: training tensors only; no augmentation at held-out evaluation other than the preregistered evaluation transforms

decision.PASS_PHOTOMETRIC_AUGMENTATION_SCOPED: source/audit integrity passes; all six candidates per arm pass strict validator; neither arm accepts a wrong layout/coordinate; augmentation has no fewer accepted-exact perturbed rows than control and strictly improves at least one
decision.HOLD_NO_SAFE_BENEFIT: integrity passes but PASS criteria do not
decision.STOP: missing/mismatched source, GPU/runtime mismatch, nondeterministic or infrastructure failure; no retry

execution_environment.docker_status: preflight failed with local content-store I/O errors; no Docker image was changed or cleaned

source_pins.freeze_rule: SHA256 of this preregistration, trainer, auditor, validator, and schema are recorded in FROZEN_IMAGE.json before formal GPU allocation
